name: omnibill/odoo
description: Omnibill Odoo: Odoo's accounting (Odoo 19 and later, Online or self-hosted) for omnisense/omnibill's journal-entries and contacts contracts - entries posted to a journal with their accounts, partners and VAT lines, then posted and read back with their number; customers and suppliers created, updated, read, listed - through Odoo's external JSON-2 API with a user's API key (XML-RPC and JSON-RPC, removed in Odoo 22, are never called).
